spinner: A thin ring cut out of the oxide film that turns, so every wavelength passes the top in turn: the film's own angle, moving.
skeleton: Cut slots with a film line along their foot that arrive once as two wavelengths out of register, converging and clearing like the headline.
switch: A machined slot with four corner brackets; on, the near-white plate slides across and the film runs along the slot's foot.
check: The box becomes the near-white plate with a film foot and its tick resolves from two colours out of register; the radio's dot resolves the same way.
toast: The toast's edge is the film, and it arrives with the film washed over the whole plate, which clears to near-black as it settles.
dialog: Developed like an anodised part: the film floods the cut plate and clears while the dialog settles from slightly large.
tooltip: A label with two corners cut and a film edge, opening from its centre outwards as the cut edges move apart like brackets.
steps: Numbers on cut plates; finished steps carry the film behind a dark tick, and four brackets close round the current step.
empty: An instrument with no signal: measuring brackets at four corners over a faint grid, and a flat trace of film under the words.
link: A quiet underline at rest that gives way to a 2px line of the film under the pointer, the one place colour appears.
